context: A mom hears her young son out about a school worry
purpose: Teach: ひとこと/おいら/ポジティブ/多彩/過言/漠然と/心境/好感

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、おいら明日の発表会、なんか漠然と不安なんだ…
lines.en: Mom, I just feel kind of vaguely uneasy about tomorrow's presentation...
lines.style: Small hesitant voice, looking down at his shoes nervously

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あら、どうしたの?ひとことでいいから、何が心配か教えて。
lines.en: Oh, what's wrong? Just in a word, tell me what worries you.
lines.style: Gentle warm tone, kneeling down to his eye level

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: みんなの前で話すの初めてで…今のおいらの心境、正直に言うと逃げ出したいよ。
lines.en: It's my first time speaking in front of everyone... honestly, right now I want to run away.
lines.style: Voice trembling slightly, fidgeting with his sleeve fabric

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そっか、怖いよね。でも翔は好きなものいっぱいあって、話せる話題が多彩じゃない。
lines.en: I see, it's scary, isn't it. But Sho, you have so many things you love—your topics are really varied.
lines.style: Reassuring smile, brushing his hair back softly with one hand

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: でも、おいらの発表、つまらないって思われたらどうしよう…
lines.en: But what if everyone thinks my presentation is boring...
lines.style: Quiet whisper, eyes welling up a little with worry

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔はみんなに好かれてるよ。クラスの人気者って言っても過言じゃないくらい、みんな好感持ってるんだから。
lines.en: Everyone likes you, Sho. It's not an exaggeration to say you're the class favorite—everyone has a good impression of you.
lines.style: Confident loving voice, hands placed gently on his shoulders

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 本当?ちょっとだけ気持ちが軽くなったかも…
lines.en: Really? Maybe my heart feels a little lighter now...
lines.style: Tiny shy smile breaking through the worry slowly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうそう、ポジティブな気持ちでいけば、きっと大丈夫だからね。
lines.en: That's right, if you go in with a positive feeling, it'll definitely be okay.
lines.style: Bright encouraging tone, giving him a gentle warm hug
